species.name: Macaw
mustRead: tail streamer far longer than the body
bare white facial patch traced with fine feather lines
species.note: perched in side profile it is much taller than wide because the tail hangs vertically

species.name: Parrot
mustRead: short deeply hooked beak with a fleshy cere
zygodactyl feet, two toes forward two back
compact stocky body with a short squared tail

species.name: Toucan
mustRead: oversized brightly banded bill nearly as long as the body
black body with a vivid yellow-white bib
bare blue skin ringing the eye
species.note: the bill is huge but very light and slightly downcurved, not a straight cone

species.name: Hornbill
mustRead: huge downcurved bill topped by a hollow casque
bare coloured throat and eye skin with long lashes

species.name: Hummingbird
mustRead: needle-thin bill at least as long as the head
narrow blade-like wings blurred in a hover
species.note: the feet are tiny and tucked; hummingbirds hover with the body held near-vertical, not horizontal

species.name: Kingfisher
mustRead: dagger bill disproportionately long and straight
oversized head with no visible neck
stubby body and very short tail

species.name: Owl
mustRead: upright barrel body with no visible neck
species.note: the 'ear tufts' are feathers, not ears; the wings fold flat against the body and the tail barely projects

species.name: Peacock
mustRead: extremely long trailing train covered in eyespots
species.note: the 'tail' is a train of upper tail coverts and only the male has it; unfanned it drags behind, making the bird very long

species.name: Vulture
mustRead: hunched shoulders above a thick feather ruff
species.note: generic representative: an Old World griffon-type vulture; perched it hunches with the head drawn into the ruff

species.name: Guineafowl
mustRead: tiny bare blue-and-red head with a bony helmet casque
round hunched body densely speckled with white dots
thin naked neck on a heavy body
species.note: the head is comically small for the body and the tail droops downward

species.name: Tanager
mustRead: compact songbird body with a squared tail
species.note: generic representative: a scarlet/tropical tanager - a small perching songbird, roughly sparrow-sized

species.name: Pheasant
mustRead: red bare facial wattle around the eye
iridescent green-black head with a white neck ring
species.note: generic representative: a common/ring-necked pheasant male; the tail alone is longer than the body

species.name: Woodpecker
mustRead: body clinging vertically to a trunk
stiff pointed tail feathers braced against the bark
species.note: normally drawn clinging vertically, so it reads much taller than wide; the head is often crested or red-capped

species.name: Hawk
mustRead: hooked raptor beak with yellow cere
heavy scaled feet with curved talons
broad rounded wings folded over the back
species.note: Read as a generic buteo (red-tailed type). Perched profile is taller than wide; the body sits at a steep angle.

species.name: Raven
species.note: Bigger-billed and shaggier-throated than a crow, with a wedge rather than a square tail.

species.name: Robin
species.note: Read as American robin: a large thrush, not the tiny round European robin.

species.name: Cardinal
mustRead: black face mask around a thick conical orange bill

species.name: Turkey
mustRead: bare warty blue-and-red head with dangling wattle
bristly beard hanging from the breast

species.name: Heron
mustRead: long neck kinked into an S
stilt legs with long trailing toes
species.note: Read as great blue heron. Neck folds back in an S at rest; it is not held straight like a stork's.

species.name: Grouse
mustRead: broad fannable barred tail and feathered legs

species.name: Goose
species.note: Read as Canada goose: black neck and head with a white chinstrap.

species.name: Duck
species.note: Read as mallard. Neck is short and thick, unlike a goose's or swan's.
